chunks.arabic_text: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ:

translations.en: And in the narration of Abān ibn ʿUthmān, he said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا

translations.en: A man asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who appointed another man as his executor, stating that he had a debt upon him.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «يَقْضِي الرَّجُلُ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَيْنِهِ وَيَقْسِمُ مَا بَقِيَ بَيْنَ الْوَرَثَةِ»

translations.en: So he said: “The man settles what is due upon him of his debt, and he divides what remains among the heirs.”

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَيُفَرِّقُ الْوَصِيُّ مَا كَانَ أُوصِيَ بِهِ فِي الدَّيْنِ مِمَّنْ يُؤْخَذُ الدَّيْنُ أَمِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ أَمْ مِنَ الْوَصِيِّ

translations.en: I said: “Then does the executor distribute what was bequeathed regarding the debt? From whom is the debt taken — from the heirs or from the executor?”

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ وَلَكِنَّ الْوَصِيَّ ضَامِنٌ لَهُ».

translations.en: He said: “It is not taken from the heirs; rather, the executor is liable for it.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: "یہ وارثوں سے نہیں لیا جاتا؛ بلکہ وصی اس کا ذمہ دار ہوتا ہے۔"
translations.tr: Şöyle dedi: "Bu, mirasçılardan alınmaz; aksine, vasiyet eden sorumludur."
translations.fa: فرمود: «از وراثت گرفته نمی‌شود؛ بلکه وصی مسئول آن است.»
translations.id: Dia berkata: "Itu tidak diambil dari ahli waris; melainkan pelaksana wasiat yang bertanggung jawab."
translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: “এটি উত্তরাধিকারীদের কাছ থেকে নেওয়া হয় না; বরং বাস্তবায়নকারী এর জন্য দায়ী।”
translations.es: Él dijo: “No se toma de los herederos; más bien, el albacea es responsable de ello.”
translations.fr: Il a dit : « Cela ne se prend pas des héritiers ; c’est plutôt l’exécuteur testamentaire qui en est responsable. »
translations.de: Er sagte: „Es wird nicht von den Erben genommen; vielmehr haftet der Testamentsvollstrecker dafür.“
translations.ru: Он сказал: «Это не берется с наследников; напротив, исполнитель завещания несет за это ответственность.»
translations.zh: 他说：“这不是从继承人那里取的；而是执行人对此负责。”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning debts left by a deceased person and the role of the executor. It states that the debt must be settled before the estate is divided among the heirs, and that liability in this case falls upon the executor rather than the heirs. The narration highlights the priority of debt repayment in inheritance matters.
en.seo_question: Who is responsible for a deceased person’s debt before the inheritance is distributed?

key_terms.أَوْصَى: appointed by will or made a bequest
key_terms.دَيْنًا: a debt owed by the deceased
key_terms.الْوَرَثَةِ: the legal heirs of the deceased
key_terms.الْوَصِيُّ: the executor appointed through the will
